WL.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE #{SEARCH_TXT} || '%'
W.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_TXT_NM}
WL.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE #{SEARCH_TXT} || '%' OR W.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_TXT_NM}

choose.when: SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectOvrTimeByReprtsDetail : 업무보고서 상세 시간외근무시간 조회 (모바일상담) */ NVL(TRUNC((A.OVTIME_WORK_DT - A.WORK_END_DT) * 24 * 60), 0) AS OVTIME_WORK_TIME FROM AYC300 A /* 업무보고서 */ , AYC495 B /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ WHERE A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN = #{TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN} /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ AND A.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = B.INDEX_SN(+) /* 업무일정일련번호 */
choose.otherwise: WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + (INTERVAL '8' HOUR) AS OVTIME_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectOvrTimeByReprtsDetail : 업무보고서 상세 시간외근무시간 조회 */ (MAX(A.CHTT_END_DT) - TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) * 24 * 60 AS OVTIME_WORK_TIME FROM AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */, TMP WHERE TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_END_DT} AND TO_CHAR(TMP.OVTIME_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */

mapper.select: /* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectBreakTimeByReprtsDetail : 업무보고서 상세 휴게시간 조회 */ WITH AAA AS ( SELECT A.USER_ID AS ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(S2.FLNM_ENCPT) AS NM , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.BGNG_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') - 1/24 AS T11 /* 배정시작 - 1시간 */ , CASE WHEN B.BGNG_HR > B.END_HR THEN TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 ELSE TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD||B.END_HR,'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') END AS T12 /* 배정종료시간 */ FROM AYC100 A , AYC110 B , SAA200 S1 , SCA100 S2 WHERE 1=1 AND S1.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND S1.ENFSN_NO = S2.ENFSN_NO AND A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND A.USER_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.WORK_YMD = REPLACE(#{WORK_YMD}, '-', '') ) SELECT ID AS USER_ID , NM AS USER_NAME , CD AS DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD , SUBSTR(CURR_CHG_DT, 9, 2) || '시 ' || SUBSTR(CURR_CHG_DT, 11, 2) || '분' AS START_BREAK_TIME , SUBSTR(NEXT_CHG_DT, 9, 2) || '시 ' || SUBSTR(NEXT_CHG_DT, 11, 2) || '분' AS END_BREAK_TIME , TERM_TIME AS TERM_BREAK_TIME , SUM(TERM_TIME) OVER() AS TOTAL_BREAK_TIME FROM ( SELECT ID , NM , CD , TO_CHAR(CHG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS CURR_CHG_DT , TO_CHAR(LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER(ORDER BY ID, CHG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS NEXT_CHG_DT , NVL(ROUND((LEAD(CHG_DT) OVER ( ORDER BY ID,CHG_DT ) - CHG_DT) * 24 * 60,0),0) AS TERM_TIME FROM ( SELECT C.ID ID, C.NM NM, A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD CD, A.CHG_DT CHG_DT FROM AYB202 A , AAA C WHERE 1=1 AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD IN ('10','11','14','15') AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = C.ID AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN C.T11 AND C.T12 UNION ALL SELECT C.ID ID, C.NM NM, '99' CD, C.T12 CHG_DT FROM AAA C ORDER BY ID, CHG_DT ) ) WHERE CD = '11' AND TERM_TIME != '0'

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectReprtsDetailPopupBaseInfo : 업무보고서 상세팝업 기본정보 조회 */ C.FLNM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_FLNM /* 상담사성명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.WORK_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORG_WORK_BGNG_DT /* 원본근무시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.WORK_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ORG_WORK_END_DT /* 원본근무종료일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.WORK_BGNG_DT - (INTERVAL '2' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT /* 근무시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.WORK_BGNG_DT + (INTERVAL '6' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_END_DT /* 근무종료일시 */ , A.WORK_YMD AS PLAN_YMD /* 계획일자 */ , A.RPLNSM_WORK_YMD /* 보충근무일자 */ FROM AYC300 A /* 업무보고서 */ , SAA200 B /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ WHERE A.TASKWK_REPRTS_INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN} /* 업무보고서색인일련번호 */ AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = B.USER_ID /* 사용자아이디 */ AND C.ENFSN_NO = B.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectOvtimeAplyHistbDetail : 시간외근무신청 LIST */ CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , NCKN_NM /* 닉네임명 */ , TO_CHAR(CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ , TRUNC((CHTT_END_DT - TO_DATE(#{ORG_WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) * 24 * 60) AS OVRTIME_WORK_HR /* 초과근무시간 */ , OVTIME_WORK_YMD /* 시간외근무일자 */ , CASE WHEN OVTIME_WORK_YMD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS APLY_YN /* 신청여부 */ FROM AYB200 /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE TO_CHAR(CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{ORG_WORK_END_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ ORDER BY CHTT_END_DT ASC

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChttDscsnListByDetail : 업무보고서 상세 > 채팅상담목록 조회 */ CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , NCKN_NM /* 닉네임명 */ , TO_CHAR(CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ FROM AYB200 /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE TO_CHAR(CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ ORDER BY CHRO_NO

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectNtabrdDscsnListByDetail : 업무보고서 상세 > 게시판상담목록 조회 */ A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , A.RETE_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ FROM AYE120 A /* 사이버상담답글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT}
AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '31'
AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '33'
AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '34'
AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '01'
AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = #{NTABRD_TYPE_VALUE} /* 게시판유형값 */ )
ORDER BY A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO

choose.when: SELECT B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , NVL(B.BBSCTT_TTL_NM, '[제목없음]') AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ FROM AYE110 A /* 사이버상담댓글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '02' /* 게시글유형구분코드: 02 (도담쌤응원메세지) */ ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO
choose.otherwise: SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectCmntNtabrdDscsnListByDetail : 업무보고서 상세 > 게시판상담목록 조회 (댓글게시판) */ B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , '[댓글] RE:' || B.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ FROM AYE110 A /* 사이버상담댓글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = 'board_coun' /* 게시판유형값: 댓글상담실 */ ) UNION ALL SELECT B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , '[이음-e] '|| A.RETE_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ FROM AYE120 A /* 사이버상담답글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 = 'board_eum' /* 게시판유형값: 이음-e */ ) ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectOutrcDscsnListByDetail : 업무보고서 상세 > 아웃리치상담목록 조회 */ A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글고유번호 */ , CD1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_NM /* 아웃리치상담방법명 */ , CD2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS PROBM_TYPE_NM /* 문제유형명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ FROM AYE100 A /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , SAC100 CD1 /* 공통코드값1 (아웃리치상담방법명) */ , SAC100 CD2 /* 공통코드값2 (문제유형명) */ WHERE 1=1 AND CD1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD' /* 공통코드1아이디: 아웃리치상담방법구분코드 */ AND CD1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD /* 공통코드1값: 아웃리치상담방법구분코드 */ AND CD2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 공통코드2아이디: 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CD2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 공통코드2값: 위기유형구분코드 */ AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' /* 게시글유형구분코드 : 사이버아웃리치 (35) 로 고정 */ AND A.OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = #{OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD} /* 아웃리치상담방법구분코드 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ ORDER BY BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectBfeChttDscsnHistbInqDetail : 이전채팅상담내역 */ NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ , A.CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , A.CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , A.CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ , A.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담사명 */ , A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT AS CLIENA_NM /* 내담자명 */ , A.CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_YN /* 상담사설문작성여부 */ , A.EMPLA_NO /* 사원번호 */ , A.NCKN_NM /* 닉네임명 */ , A.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD /* 상담영역구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD ) AS DSCSN_RELM_SE_NM /* 상담영역구분명 */ , A.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD /* 게시판상담실직업구분코드 */ , A.ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , A.GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , A.CYSNET_ESNTAL_NO /* CYSNET고유번호 */ , A.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CLIENA_IP_ADDR /* 내담자아이피주소 */ , B.BGNG_DT /* 시작일시 */ , B.END_DT /* 종료일시 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MOD(B.REST_HR, 86400), 'SSSSS'), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS REST_HR /* 휴식시간 */ , A.CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모내용 */ , A.CHTT_DSCSN_CN /* 채팅상담내용 */ , 0 AS CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_INDEX_SN /* 상담사설문작성일련번호 (사용안함) */ , NVL(A.SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN, 'N') AS SUPV_SLCTN_CASE_YN /* 슈퍼비전선정사례여부 */ FROM AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */ , AYB230 B /* 심플_로그_ing */ WHERE A.CHRO_NO = B.CHRO_NO AND A.CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO} /* 채팅방번호 */

WITH TMP AS ( SELECT X.CHRO_NO , SUM(X.INDEX_SN) AS CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_INDEX_SN /* 상담사설문작성일련번호 (사용안함) */ FROM ( SELECT CHRO_NO, 0 AS INDEX_SN FROM AYB200 WHERE CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO} /* 채팅방번호 */ AND CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_YN IS NOT NULL ) X GROUP BY X.CHRO_NO ) SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChttDscsnHistbInqDetail : 채팅상담내역 */ NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ , A.CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , A.CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , A.CLIENA_ID /* 내담자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ , A.CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담사명 */ , A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT AS CLIENA_NM /* 내담자명 */ , A.CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_YN /* 상담사설문작성여부 */ , A.EMPLA_NO /* 사원번호 */ , A.NCKN_NM /* 닉네임명 */ , A.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD /* 상담영역구분코드 */ , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.DSCSN_RELM_SE_CD ) AS DSCSN_RELM_SE_NM /* 상담영역구분명 */ , A.NTABRD_CSC_OCCP_SE_CD /* 게시판상담실직업구분코드 */ , A.ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력구분코드 */ , A.GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년구분코드 */ , A.CYSNET_ESNTAL_NO /* CYSNET고유번호 */ , A.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CLIENA_IP_ADDR /* 내담자아이피주소 */ , A.CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모내용 */ , A.CHTT_DSCSN_CN /* 채팅상담내용 */ , Z.CNSLTNT_SRVY_WRT_INDEX_SN /* 상담사설문작성일련번호 (사용안함) */ FROM AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */ , TMP Z /* 임시테이블 */ WHERE A.CHRO_NO = Z.CHRO_NO AND A.CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO} /* 채팅방번호 */ ORDER BY A.CHRO_NO DESC

WITH TMP AS ( SELECT CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ FROM AYB200 /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE CHRO_NO = #{CHRO_NO} /* 채팅방번호 */ ) SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChttLogUserInfo : 채팅로그사용자 정보조회 */ A.CNTN_IP_ADDR /* 접속아이피주소 */ , A.CNTN_DT /* 접속일시 */ , A.CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ FROM AYB250 A /* 채팅로그사용자 */, TMP WHERE A.CHRO_NO = TMP.CHRO_NO(+) AND A.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 사용자아이디 */ AND A.CNTN_DT <= TMP.CHTT_BGNG_DT AND A.CHTT_END_DT >= TMP.CHTT_END_DT

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectNtabrdDscsnHistbInqDetail : 게시판상담내역 */ A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 원글고유번호 */ , A.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 원글제목명 */ , A.BBSCTT_CN /* 게시글내용 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS ORG_REG_DT /* 원글작성일시 */ , B.RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , B.RETE_TTL_NM /* 답글제목명 */ , B.RETE_CN /* 답글내용 */ , TO_CHAR(B.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MM:SS') AS RETE_REG_DT /* 답변글작성일시 */ FROM AYE100 A /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , AYE120 B /* 사이버상담답글 */ WHERE A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = #{BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 게시글유형구분코드 */ AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /* 원글고유번호 */ AND B.RETE_ESNTAL_NO = #{RETE_ESNTAL_NO} /* 답글고유번호 */

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectWorkDateTime : 업무보고서 - 근무 시작시간, 종료시간 구하기 */
SELECT TO_CHAR(T.WORK_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WORK_YMD /* 근무일자 (YYYY-MM-DD) */ , T.BGNG_HR /* 시작시간 */ , T.END_HR /* 종료시간 */ , T.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN /* 업무일정일련번호 */ , T.CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , T.WORK_BGNG_DT /* 근무시작일시 */ , CASE WHEN REPLACE(T.BGNG_HR, ':', '') >= 2000 THEN TO_DATE(T.NEXT_WORK_DT||' '||T.END_HR||':00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(T.WORK_DT||' '||T.END_HR||':00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END AS WORK_END_DT /* 근무종료일시 */ FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WORK_DT /* 근무일자 */ , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + (INTERVAL '1' DAY) AS NEXT_WORK_DT /* 다음근무일자 */ , A.WORK_YMD , B.BGNG_HR , B.END_HR , A.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN , A.USER_ID AS CNSLTNT_ID , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(B.BGNG_HR, ':', '') || '00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WORK_BGNG_DT FROM AYC100 A /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC110 B /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE A.USER_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{WORK_YMD} AND B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO ) T

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectEvalutaionOpt : 업무보고서 - 자기평가표작성 옵션 조회 */
SELECT NVL(A.NTABRD_EVL_YN, 'N') AS NTABRD_EVL_YN /* 게시판평가여부 */ , NVL(A.CHTT_EVL_YN, 'N') AS CHTT_EVL_YN /* 채팅평가여부 */ , C.OGDP_DEPT_CD /* 소속부서코드 */ , C.FLNM_ENCPT AS CNSLTNT_FLNM /* 상담사성명 */ FROM AYC150 A /* 근무배정표_인큐베이팅 */ , SAA200 B /* 사용자 */ LEFT JOIN SCA100 C ON B.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO /* 종사자번호 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.CONSTT_ID (+)= B.USER_ID AND B.USER_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND A.INCUBA_WORK_YMD (+)= #{WORK_YMD} /* 인큐베이팅근무일자 */

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChatMemo : 업무보고서 - 채팅내역의 메모 가져오기 */ SELECT A.CHRO_NM /* 채팅방명 */ , A.CLIENA_NM_ENCPT AS CLIENA_NM /* 내담자명암호화 */ , A.CHTT_MEMO_CN /* 채팅메모내용 */ FROM AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN #{WORK_BGNG_DT} AND #{WORK_END_DT} AND A.CHTT_MEMO_CN IS NOT NULL

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectMobileCrisisNocs : 업무보고서 - 모바일 위기 및 연계 건수, 사후관리 카운팅 */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_YMD}||' '||#{BGNG_HR}||':00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - (INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS DSCSN_START_DT
, TO_DATE(#{WORK_YMD}||' '||#{END_HR}||':00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + (INTERVAL '1' DAY) + (INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS DSCSN_END_DT
, TO_DATE(#{WORK_YMD}||' '||#{END_HR}||':00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + (INTERVAL '2' HOUR) AS DSCSN_END_DT
FROM DUAL ) SELECT T.LINK_NOCS /* 연계건수 */ , T.CRISIS_NOCS /* 위기건수 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AYA190 A, TMP /* 사후관리 */ WHERE A.CONSTT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담원아이디*/ AND TO_CHAR(A.DSCSN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') /* 상담일시 */ BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.DSCSN_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.DSCSN_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) AS AFTFCT_MNG_NOCS /* 사후관리건수 */ FROM ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LINK_NOCS , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD <> '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CRISIS_NOCS FROM AYA120 A, TMP /* 위기상담_개인 */ WHERE A.CONSTT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담원아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.DSCSN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') /* 상담일시 */ BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.DSCSN_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.DSCSN_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) T

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChttDscsnHistbList : 채팅상담내역 List */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_START_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT A.CHRO_NO /* 채팅방번호 */ , A.CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담사아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MM:SS') AS CHTT_BGNG_DT /* 채팅시작일시 */ , TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MM:SS') AS CHTT_END_DT /* 채팅종료일시 */ , C.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM /* 성명암호화 */ , A.CHTT_DSCSN_CN /* 채팅상담내용 */ FROM AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */ , SAA200 B /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ , TMP /* 임시테이블 (근무시간범위)*/ WHERE A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_START_DT - (INTERVAL '2' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_END_DT + (INTERVAL '2' HOUR), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND B.USER_ID = A.CNSLTNT_ID AND C.ENFSN_NO = B.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY CHTT_BGNG_DT ASC

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectNtabrdDscsnHistList : 게시판상담내역 List */ WITH TMP AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{WORK_BGNG_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_START_DT , TO_DATE(#{WORK_END_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) SELECT A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드*/ , B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 원글고유번호 */ , B.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 원글제목명 */ , A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , A.RETE_TTL_NM /* 답글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RETE_REG_DT /* 답변글일시 */ FROM AYE120 A /* 사이버상담답글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , TMP /* 임시테이블 (근무시간범위)*/ WHERE A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('05', '06', '07') AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') /* 최초등록일시 */ BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_START_DT - (INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_END_DT + (INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') UNION SELECT A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /* 게시글유형구분코드*/ , B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 원글고유번호 */ , B.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 원글제목명 */ , A.RETE_ESNTAL_NO /* 답글고유번호 */ , A.RETE_TTL_NM /* 답글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RETE_REG_DT /* 답변글일시 */ FROM AYE120 A /* 사이버상담답글 */ , AYE100 B /* 사이버상담게시글 */ , TMP /* 임시테이블 (근무시간범위)*/ WHERE A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD IN ('31', '34') /* 게시글유형구분코드: naver, daum */ AND A.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = B.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND A.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = B.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND A.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') /* 최초등록일시 */ BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_START_DT - (INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_CHAR(TMP.WK_END_DT + (INTERVAL '1' DAY), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectExistTaskwkReprts : 업무보고서 중복체크 */ COUNT(*) AS EXIST_CNT FROM AYC300 WHERE TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = #{taskSchdlSn} /* 업무일정일련번호 */

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectWorkDateTimeByReg : 근무 시작시간, 종료시간 구하기 (등록) */
SELECT TO_CHAR(T.WK_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_START_DT , TO_CHAR(T.WK_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_END_DT FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || ' ' || B.BGNG_HR, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_START_DT , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || ' ' || B.BGNG_HR, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + (INTERVAL '4' HOUR) AS WK_END_DT FROM AYC100 A /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , AYC110 B /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO /* 사업계획관리번호 */ AND A.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN = #{TASKWK_SCHDL_SN} AND A.USER_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} ) T

/* * SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectOutrcInfoByReg : 사이버아웃리치 정보 조회 (등록) * 2023.07.06 수정 - Jeong.Won.Je */
WITH COMMON AS ( SELECT * FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' ) , TMP AS ( SELECT T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , CASE WHEN T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM IS NOT NULL THEN T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO || '_' || T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM ELSE NULL END AS CRISIS_NM , T1.OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD AS OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD , T2.TYPE_SE_NM AS TYPE_SE_NM FROM AYE100 T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN AYA110 T2 ON T1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = T2.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = T2.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN COMMON T3 ON T2.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE WHERE T1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '35' AND T1.FRST_RGTR_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND TO_CHAR(T1.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') = REPLACE(#{WORK_YMD}, '-') AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ) SELECT ( SELECT NVL(COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO), 0) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' ) AS MSNGR_NOCS /* 메신저건수 */ , ( SELECT NVL(COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO), 0) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '7' ) AS CMNT_DSCSN_NOCS /* 댓글상담건수 */ , ( SELECT NVL(COUNT(BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO), 0) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '6' ) AS PR_NOCS /* 홍보건수 */ , ( SELECT LISTAGG(CRISIS_NM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NULL) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '1' --AND TYPE_SE_NM IN ('outreach') /* 2022.11.11 (TO-BE 이관시) 사용안함 */ ) AS MSNGR_CRCO_CN /* 메신저위기상담내용 */ , ( SELECT LISTAGG(CRISIS_NM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NULL) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '7' --AND TYPE_SE_NM IN ('outreach') /* 2022.11.11 (TO-BE 이관시) 사용안함 */ ) AS CMNT_DSCSN_CRCO_CN /* 댓글상담위기상담내용 */ , ( SELECT LISTAGG(CRISIS_NM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NULL) FROM TMP WHERE OUTRC_DSCSN_MTHD_SE_CD = '6' --AND TYPE_SE_NM IN ('outreach') /* 2022.11.11 (TO-BE 이관시) 사용안함 */ ) AS PR_CRCO_CN /* 홍보위기상담내용 */ FROM DUAL

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectChatOpenTimeByReg : 채팅방 개설시간 조회 (등록) */
SELECT TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHTT_ATENDB_DT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{WK_START_DT}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - (INTERVAL '60' MINUTE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WK_START_DT , #{WK_END_DT} AS WK_END_DT FROM DUAL ) T , AYB200 A /* 채팅이력 */ WHERE A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} /* 상담사아이디 */ AND TO_CHAR(A.CHTT_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') BETWEEN T.WK_START_DT AND T.WK_END_DT AND ROWNUM <= 1 ORDER BY A.CHRO_NO ASC

/* SQL-ID : isry.couns.taskwksprt.taskwkandatdmng.mapper.TaskwkReprtsMapper.selectFrstAtenDbInfo : AYB202(깃플챗상담원상태관리)에서 상담상태구분코드 = '10'인 시간 순으로 첫번째 데이터 조회 */ SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(A.CHG_DT), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ATENDB_DT /* 전일 또는 당일 출근일시 */ FROM AYB202 A , ( SELECT USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 사용자아이디 */ , WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD /* 근무기준일자 */ , BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR /* 조회시작시간 */ , END_HR AS END_HR /* 조회종료시간 */ , CRTR_HR AS CRTR_HR /* 기준시간 */ , BGNG_DT - 1/24 AS BGNG_DT /* 조회시작일시 기준일시 한시간전 */ , BGNG_DT + (CRTR_HR/24) AS END_DT /* 조회시작일시 + 근무시간 */ FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID AS USER_ID , B.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR , B.END_HR AS END_HR , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || B.BGNG_HR , 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') AS BGNG_DT , TO_DATE(A.WORK_YMD || B.END_HR , 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') AS END_DT , A.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(B.BGNG_HR, 0, 2) > SUBSTR(B.END_HR, 0, 2) THEN (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.END_HR, 0, 2)) + 24) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.BGNG_HR, 0, 2)) ELSE (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.END_HR, 0, 2))) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(B.BGNG_HR, 0, 2)) END AS CRTR_HR FROM AYC100 A , AYC110 B WHERE A.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = B.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND A.WORK_YMD = REPLACE(#{WORK_YMD}, '-', '') /* 업무보고서 등록할 근무일자 */ AND A.USER_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} ) ) B WHERE A.CNSLTNT_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.CNSLTNT_ID = #{CNSLTNT_ID} AND A.DSCSN_STTS_SE_CD IN ('10', '15') AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN B.BGNG_DT AND B.END_DT
